subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are writing to confirm your reservation at the Grand Hotel for your upcoming trip to New York City. Your stay is scheduled for October 15th to October 18th. Please review the attached itinerary for more details. If you have any questions or need to make changes, feel free to contact us at your earliest convenience. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel! Best regards, The Grand Hotel Team
